definitions.full: H4367. Maknadbay מַכְנַדְּבַי proper name, masculine one of those who had taken strange wives Ezra 10:40 (Gray Expos. Times, Feb. 1889, p. 233 proposes מכרנבו = possession of Nebo ); ᵐ5 Μαξαδναβου , A Μαχναδααβου ; ᵐ5 L Ναδαβου .
